description: Source code for a Zephyr-based Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) logging backend, implementing BLE GATT services and characteristics for log transmission, including connection management, notification handling, and integration with Zephyr's logging framework.

methods.name: logger_backend_ble_set_hook
methods.description: Sets a user-defined hook and context for BLE backend.

methods.name: log_backend_ble_connect
methods.description: Handles BLE connection establishment, storing the connection object.

methods.name: log_backend_ble_disconnect
methods.description: Handles BLE disconnection, clearing the connection object.

methods.name: log_notify_changed
methods.description: Callback for BLE notification subscription changes, enabling or disabling logging accordingly.

methods.name: line_out
methods.description: Outputs log data via BLE notifications, managing MTU size and notification parameters.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes log messages and outputs them via BLE, respecting panic mode and log format.

methods.name: format_set
methods.description: Sets the current log format for the backend.

methods.name: init_ble
methods.description: Initializes the BLE log backend, deactivating it initially.

methods.name: panic
methods.description: Handles panic state, disabling further logging.

methods.name: backend_ready
methods.description: Indicates the backend is not ready for logging after initialization.

methods.name: log_backend_ble_get
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the BLE log backend structure.
